words.example: Does Thursday's training roster include the people on night shift?
words.exampleZh: 周四的培训名单里有夜班人员吗？

words.example: Send the attendance sheet around the table before training begins.
words.exampleZh: 培训开始前，请把签到表在桌上传递一圈。

words.example: After class, put a feedback form on the seat of every chair.
words.exampleZh: 下课之后，请在每张椅子上放一份反馈表。

words.example: Remember that the satisfaction survey closes at five on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 请记住，满意度调查在周五五点截止。

words.example: This pulse survey only asks the front desk three short questions.
words.exampleZh: 这次快问快答调查只向前台提三个简短问题。

words.example: Add her to the security group that can open the pharmacy share.
words.exampleZh: 把她加进能打开药房共享的那个安全组。

words.example: Mail to the distribution group for charge nurses never reached the night shift.
words.exampleZh: 发给责任护士通讯组的邮件没有送到夜班。

words.example: A nested group hid her access, so the pharmacy share denied her this morning.
words.exampleZh: 嵌套组把她的权限藏住了，今天早上药房共享拒绝了她。

words.example: Her group membership changed at noon, but the old token lasts until she signs in again.
words.exampleZh: 她的组成员关系中午改了，但旧令牌要等她重新登录才失效。

words.example: The sid on this cloned PC matches another machine, so domain join fails.
words.exampleZh: 这台克隆电脑的安全标识和另一台机器重复，加域因此失败。
